# tu_order.py sample output
# Generated by: python3 -m vostok diff tu-order --short <TU>
# (committed as a reference demonstration; reflects match.db at commit time)
#
# Ordering is by PDB SOURCE LINE (the line-table line a function is defined at),
# NOT the final-image RVA: the linker scrambles RVA order on both sides, so an
# RVA-keyed diff reports a flood of FALSE reorders. Across all 1995 TUs the
# line-order key flags ~9 genuine reorders in vostok-own .cpp (mostly the
# not-yet-matched render module); the old RVA key flagged ~300 vostok .cpp TUs.

################################################################################
# 1) network_client_processing.cpp - the false-positive collapse. The RVA-order
#    key used to report 13 paired functions "out of order" here; by SOURCE LINE
#    the paired functions are in the SAME relative order (0 reorderings) - those
#    13 were pure link/COMDAT scramble, not source moves. Only the 4 target-only
#    dynamic initializer/atexit records remain as a genuine presence diff.
################################################################################
# UNIT: vostok/game/sources/network_client_processing.cpp
# TARGET functions: 42   BASE functions: 38
